vibe: Cinematic, moody, premium nightlife. The 'Pulse of Latin Music in Italy'. Italian elegance mixed with Latin passion.

hero_banner.style: Full bleed image, height 60vh. Overlay: bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/50 to-transparent. Typography aligned bottom-left.
hero_banner.usage: Home screen featured event or top DJ.

event_card.style: Glassmorphism aesthetic. bg-[#111113] rounded-3xl border border-white/10 overflow-hidden. Large image top (h-48), content bottom. Subtle inner stroke.

filter_pills.style: Horizontal scroll. Unselected: bg-[#1A1A1D] text-zinc-400 rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 border border-white/5. Selected: bg-[#E11D48] text-white font-bold.
filter_pills.usage: Events screen to filter by genre (Salsa, Bachata, Reggaeton) and City.

music_player.style: Full screen modal or sticky bottom bar. Large album art with intense drop-shadow (shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(225,29,72,0.2)]). Circular play button bg-[#E11D48].

dj_profile.style: Overlapping layout. Header image takes top 35%. Avatar (rounded-full, border-4 border-[#050505], size 24) overlaps header. Stats displayed in bento-grid.

input_fields.style: bg-[#111113] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:border-[#E11D48]

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React Native/Expo components. If using NativeWind, strictly follow the Tailwind utility classes provided.
Implement a deep dark theme. Do NOT use pure white backgrounds. Backgrounds must be #050505.
Ensure 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts are loaded via expo-font. If not available, fallback to system fonts (SF Pro / Roboto) with bold weights for headings and regular for body.
The Home screen MUST feature a cinematic hero banner using 'dj_founder' or 'hero_latin_party' image overlaid with a dark gradient to ensure text readability.
Use standard Expo `<Image>` or `expo-image` for rich media rendering. Always ensure images have `contentFit='cover'`.
Use `react-native-webview` for Spotify/Tidal playlist embeds on the DJ profiles.
All interactive elements (buttons, filter pills, event cards) MUST include a 'testID' attribute (e.g., testID='login-button') for testing.
Bottom Tab Navigator should be dark (#050505) with a border-top of rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Active tab icons should be #E11D48.
Avoid generic card layouts. Opt for 'Bento-style' grids for DJ profiles and high-contrast, border-radius 24px (rounded-3xl) for event cards.
For the Radio Player, implement a floating sticky widget right above the bottom tab bar when playing, expandable to a full screen player.
Use generous padding (p-6, px-8) to ensure the UI feels breathable and high-end.
Apply `SafeAreaView` correctly to prevent content from bleeding into the notch on iOS devices.
